standard: near-contract-standards 5.29.0: FungibleToken (NEP-141 core) + StorageManagement (NEP-145), as exposed by the near-sdk-rs fungible-token example (tag near-sdk-v5.29.0)

P1.title: Conservation
P1.text: In every reachable state, total_supply equals the sum of all account balances.

P2.title: transfer_call settlement
P2.text: When the settlement callback of an ft_transfer_call of `amount` from a sender to a receiver runs, whatever the receiver's ft_on_transfer did (returned any number, unparsable bytes, a value longer than 42 bytes, or failed), the refund to the sender is at most `amount` and at most what the receiver still holds; the receiver loses exactly the refund and no other account changes; if the sender is still registered, the sender gains exactly the refund, so the sender + receiver total and the supply are conserved; if the sender has unregistered, the refund is burned. In a reachable state the callback cannot fail for arithmetic reasons.

P3.title: Callback ownership
P3.text: ft_resolve_transfer takes effect only as the token's own settlement callback: called by any other account, by another contract, as another contract's callback with promise results of its choice, or by a transaction signed with the token account's own key, it fails and changes nothing.

P4.title: Balance ownership
P4.text: No step other than a call by the holder lowers the holder's balance, except the settlement of an ft_transfer_call made to that holder, which takes back at most the amount of that transfer. The holder's own calls that can lower it are exactly ft_transfer, ft_transfer_call and storage_unregister(force = true); a settlement in flight exists only for a transfer that credited the holder exactly that amount.

P5.title: Storage
P5.text: storage_unregister with 1 yoctoNEAR: with force = true it removes the caller's account and burns its whole balance (total_supply drops by exactly that balance) and pays the caller the storage minimum plus 1 yoctoNEAR; with a zero balance it does the same with or without force and burns nothing; without force and with a positive balance it fails and changes nothing; for an unregistered caller it changes nothing and returns false. storage_deposit registers an account for exactly the storage minimum and refunds the rest to the caller. In every reachable state the token holds enough NEAR for its base storage plus one storage refund per registered account.
